title: Purported Deepfake Ads Reportedly Fabricated BBC Question Time Confrontations Between Andrew Bailey and Nigel Farage

behaviors.text: Purported AI-generated ads on X reportedly depicted Bank of England governor a person and Reform UK leader a person in fabricated physical confrontations on a BBC Question Time-style set.
The ads allegedly used the staged Bailey-Farage clash to present an investment scam as legitimate BBC-style financial journalism.
